pair.title: Log in to Withings
pair.instructions: A Withings login window will open. Grant access to your sleep events, then return here.
pair.missing_credentials: Withings client ID and secret are not set. Open the app settings and enter them first.
pair.not_authorized: Authorization did not complete. Please try again.

settings.intro: The app needs your own Withings application. Fill in the fields below; the guide shows how to obtain the values.
settings.saved: Saved. Restart the app or re-add the device to apply.
settings.webhook_url_hint: This Homey's subscription URL. If you need to register the full form at Withings, this is the string to paste:
settings.guide_title: How to set up your own Withings application
settings.guide_desktop: This works fine from the phone, but is easier on a computer. Long keys are simpler to paste, and you will be in a browser at Withings anyway. Homey's developer tools have the same fields under App Settings:
settings.guide_order: Take the steps in this order, because the webhook id is part of the URL you register at Withings, so the webhook has to exist first.
settings.guide_step1_body: Create a new webhook and pick "Query Parameter" as the matching strategy. That is what routes ?homey=… to the right Homey. Copy the ID and Secret into the fields below. Without a webhook the app still works, but polls instead of receiving events instantly.
settings.guide_step2_body: Choose "Public API integration", since the other types are only available under contract. Name it whatever you like. The Client ID and Secret appear on the overview page afterwards, and the secret is shown once. Use "Renew" if you lose it.
settings.guide_step2_urls: Register this as a Registered URL. It receives the login:
settings.guide_step2_slash: The trailing slash on the callback URL matters. It is compared character by character, and without it login fails with an error that does not say what is wrong.
settings.guide_step2_base: Add the webhook URL as the second Registered URL. Register it without a query:
settings.guide_step2_scopes: The app requests user.info, user.metrics, user.activity and user.sleepevents. Without user.sleepevents the subscriptions are created but no bed events are ever delivered.
settings.guide_step3_body: Fill in the four fields above, press Save, then Test connection. The test asks Withings for a nonce, the same signed call the app makes when refreshing a token, and checks that the webhook answers. It also shows which source supplied the values.
settings.show_identity: Show Homey id and subscription URL
settings.identity_no_webhook: (No webhook id saved yet, so the placeholder above is filled in once you save one.)
settings.copy_failed: Could not copy, select the text manually
settings.no_webhook_url: No subscription URL yet. Fill in the Webhook ID and save, and it appears here.
